documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Management reported stable production levels and strong financial results for the quarter, highlighting debt-free status and significant cash generation. The company officially signed Revenue Sharing Contracts for KG Onshore and Cambay Basin with the Government of India. Management reaffirmed its guidance to exit the current fiscal year at around 2,500 barrels of oil equivalent per day and scale towards 5,000 barrels by FY29. Operational focus remains on developing existing fields like Bakrol and Karjisan while formulating future exploration plans for new assets. Antelopus Selan Energy Limited reported its Q2 FY27 results and operational updates, highlighting production milestones across its onshore assets like Bakrol and Karjisan.

guidance.claim: The company expects to exit the current fiscal year at around 2,500 barrels of oil gas equivalent production.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that this year we will exit at around 2,500 that is the guidance we are reasonably sure that we should be able to deliver on our promise to you of ramping up to 2,500 barrels of oil gas equivalent production from our portfolio.

guidance.claim: Production is targeted to reach around 3,500 barrels next year and 5,000 barrels thereafter.
guidance.quote: Next year, that should be around 3,500 barrels. Thereafter, that should be 5,000 barrels.

guidance.claim: Management targets building towards a 5,000 barrels business by FY29.
guidance.quote: So, therefore, we remain confident and on track for 2,500 barrels of oil equivalent exit this year and we are building towards 5,000 barrels business hopefully by FY29, with fiscal discipline remaining our key focus area as well.

guidance.claim: The company is on track for a 2,500 boepd exit.
guidance.quote: Key takeaways: On track for a 2,500 boepd exit

guidance.claim: The guidance of reaching 2,500 boepd in FY27 remains intact.
guidance.quote: Our guidance of reaching 2,500 boepdin FY’27 remains intact, as impact from Frac will be seen from Q2 onwards

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to spend approximately Rs.250 crores of capital in the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: Then we went to Rs.160 crores. Again, we went to Rs.87 crores, then Rs.220 crores, hopefully Rs.250 crores this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed the 10-well drilling campaign and fracking in Bakrol.
capex_expansion.quote: At an operational level, we just finished the 10-well drilling campaign that we had done in Bakrol. The drilling is done. The fracking is finished.

capex_expansion.claim: There will be a continuous capex cycle in the Cambay Basin for the next 3 to 4 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Continuous Capex cycle in Cambay Basin for the next 3–4 years, while KG ramps up to deliver year-on-year growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Drilling in the Cambay basin is scheduled to commence by the end of FY27.
One new well is planned in H2 FY27 to target either the Western or Central area of the Cambay block.
The next well in the Cambay field is planned for H2 FY27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir.
capex_expansion.quote: The next well is planned for H2 FY'27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter was approximately 71%, with EBITDA standing at Rs.90 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was Rs.90 crores, almost 3x to what we reported in Q2 last year with a margin at about 71%.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding a one-off Rs.6.5 crores refund, EBITDA for the quarter was about Rs.83 crores, with a margin of about 69%.
margins_costs.quote: So, even if we exclude that, the EBITDA was about Rs.83 crores. So, that takes the margin to about 69%.

margins_costs.claim: OPEX and handling costs decreased to Rs.6.1 crores from Rs.7.5 crores in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: Our OPEX and handling costs came down to Rs.6.1 crores from Rs.7.5 crores in Q1.

margins_costs.claim: Royalty and Cess remained stable at around 16% of revenue, totaling around Rs.20.5 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Royalty and Cess remained stable at around 16% of the revenue which totals around Rs.20.5 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Bakrol average production in October was around 950 barrels of oil equivalent plus.
orders_capacity.quote: Bakrol itself is set around October average production was around 950 barrels of oil equivalent plus.

orders_capacity.claim: Across the portfolio, October production reached around 2,000 barrel oil equivalent.
orders_capacity.quote: Actually, the October production itself, we are at around 2,000 barrel oil equivalent and this is what this month's production across the portfolio has been.

orders_capacity.claim: Karjisan has 2 of the 7 wells drilled, ahead of schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Ahead of schedule: 2 of the 7 wells drilled, well before the planned Q4 first spud

orders_capacity.claim: 9 of 10 planned FDP wells have been drilled so far with drilling ahead of schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: The Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21-FY23 of approximately 6.56 Cr.
capital_allocation.quote: ▪ Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the Company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21–FY23, of c. ₹6.56 Cr. whichwasearlierexpense. Toberecognizeduponreceiptoffinalorder

risks_headwinds.claim: Operational delays in fracking occurred primarily due to supply chain constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: There was a little bit of operational delays in fracking, primarily due to supply chain constraints with what is happening with the world, but that is all sorted.

management_commitments.claim: Management promises to make investor calls a regular occurrence at the end of quarterly board meetings.
management_commitments.quote: We have finally managed to have an investor call, and we promise to keep it a regular occurrence at the end of quarterly board meetings, pretty much most hopefully the same day.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to delivering on the guidance of ramping up to 2,500 barrels of oil gas equivalent production.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that this year we will exit at around 2,500 that is the guidance we are reasonably sure that we should be able to deliver on our promise to you of ramping up to 2,500 barrels of oil gas equivalent production from our portfolio.

management_commitments.claim: Continuous frac campaign is set to commence in early August with full productivity expected to flow through in Q2.
Drilling in the Cambay basin is scheduled to commence by the end of FY27.
One new well is planned in H2 FY27 to target either the Western or Central area of the Block.
The next well is planned for H2 FY27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.
management_commitments.quote: The next well is planned for H2 FY'27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.

management_commitments.claim: Re-perforation and reservoir potential testing at TS-1 and TS-2 zones will be conducted in all accessible wells through workovers post monsoon.
management_commitments.quote: ▪ Conduct Re-perforation and reservoir potential testing at TS – 1 and TS – 2 zones in all accessible wells (including DMR#1 and 2) through workovers,post monsoon

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
